data.why: The app reads only committed processed outputs under data/processed/ (dashboard_cells.parquet, fate_probabilities.parquet, driver_genes.csv, marker_expression.parquet, project_meta.json); it has no file-upload widget, so no browser-facing test files are needed.

goals: Identify how many distinct terminal fates were inferred and which annotated cell states contribute most cells to each
Determine which cell-fate decision is most strongly committed early vs late in pseudotime by comparing fate-probability distributions across the UMAP atlas
Rank the top putative driver genes for a chosen lineage (e.g. erythroid Ery_2 or megakaryocyte Mega) and export the ranked list as CSV
Check whether a specific hematopoietic marker gene's expression pattern across pseudotime is consistent with its annotated cell-state label
Assess whether a dataset-derived state label (e.g. Mono_1) is molecularly supported by its top driver genes, and note any mismatch between label and signature
Review the recorded analysis provenance (dataset, kernel, pseudotime field, package versions) to judge the reliability and reproducibility of the fate probabilities shown

review.summary: The goal and phases match the README's question and its seven views closely, and every sampled screen supports its node. A few small fixes are needed before filing: an over-split legend task, one mislabeled signature term, an unverified clipboard copy and some overlap between t1 and t4.
